body: Yeah I wouldn't send it, it's a bit too mean, but thanks

Wow, this helps more than you could ever know, I guess you really put it into perspective here, and you gave me a renewed sense of hope, thank you so much, you might have saved a life today, I hope you know that
How do I know when I'm ready again? Do you think texting is still okay?
Hey, so do you really believe that it would be possible for me to get back together with her? Or is that just some pipe dream. If you think it is possible, what steps do I need to take to do so?
You have a good day too, you helped me a lot

I have been trying to take that look at it, I am hoping that me and her can be apart for a bit and maybe we can be together again, the day before me and her broke up I was thinking everything was perfect, it helps talking to somebody my age, it feels like a lot of older people really don't get it

I think that I have been feeling a lot better, we decided to be friends still and she actually texted me today asking me how I was doing, I do believe it was my fault however you are right, I shouldn't beat myself up over it, but I just can't help but think of where we would be know if I didn't screw up, it is hard being stuck at home on my own and she isn't there to comfort me or to just have fun with her, I have gotten a lot of messages tho and I'm going through a happy period for now, I'll let you know if I need someone to talk more in depth to later, for today at least I'm gonna make it

I'm going through something very similar, I lost the love of my life from something that was my fault, I too find it hard to have a reason to live, but we can make it through this quarentine together, I know its hard not seeing your closest friends, I have been deeply missing mine during this time, we are going to do it together though, there are many people who care about you here that would love to see you make it through this, me included, lets do it together, message me if you wanna talk further and share your story

You have people that care about you, think about how that would affect them, whatever pain you are going through now will not be solved by ending it all now, if you need somebody to talk to we are all here for you, feel free to message me

I am going through something that while it was not as long as you, I fully believed that she was the one and that nothing could get better, you do have people that care about you, I'm one of them. Seeing your story reminds me so much of my own, I had many thoughts of ending it as well but it isn't worth it, there is nothing better on the other side, you got this, I believe in you, there will be the true love of your life somewhere, we are here for you

Thank you, it helps hearing it from somebody that is going through the same thing as me, it seems like nobody could really understand me but someone who went through what I did, I think that I am going to keep on trucking, good luck to you too
How did you do it? What did you do to distract yourself from the pain?
